verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Microsoft publishes an official MCP server (github.com/microsoft/mcp) that would let AI agents connect to Azure resources, satisfying the core ask. However, the pack contains no first-party documentation detail on setup, supported tools/capabilities, or independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working. missing for 10: first-party docs describing MCP server capabilities/setup, independent or hands-on verification of the connection working.
